street_name: Footpath From Gunnersbury Drive To Gunnersbury Avenue
decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - It is considered that prior approval is required.
Refusal for the reason set out below:
REASON:
The proposed telecommunication installation, by reason of its siting and appearance, would have a detrimental impact on the visual amenities of the Gunnersbury Park Conservation Area and the setting of the listed buildings of Gunnersbury Park. Furthermore following the recent relocation of a lamppost as part of a new street lighting scheme for Popes Lane, the proposal would add to the visual clutter at the locality further undermining the visual amenities of the area. As a result the proposed telecommunications installation would be contrary to policies ENV1.1, ENV1.2 and ENV1.12 of the Council's Adopted Unitary Development Plan and policies ENV-B.1.1, ENV-B.2.2 and ENV-B.1.7 of the Council's Draft Revised Unitary Development Plan.
description: Installation of a 12m high telecommunications pole and associated equipment cabin.
